'''Oleg Vladimirovich Besov''' ({{langx|ru|Олег Владимирович Бесов}}; born 1933)<ref name=r3/> is a Russian mathematician. He heads the Department of Function Theory at the [[Steklov Institute of Mathematics]], where he defended his PhD in 1960 and [[habilitation]] in 1966.<ref name=r3/> He was an Invited Speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]] in 1970 in Nice.<ref>Besov, O. V. "Théorèmes de plongement des espaces fonctionnels." Congrès int. des Math., Nice, Tome 2 (1970): 467–473.</ref> He is professor at the [[Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology]] and a member of the [[Russian Academy of Sciences]] (since 1990) and European Academy of Sciences (since 2002).<ref name=r1/><ref name=r2/> A festschrift was published in honor of Besov's 70th birthday.<ref>{{cite book|title=Function Spaces, Approximations, and Differential Equations: Collected Papers Dedicated to Oleg Vladimirovich Besov on His 70th Birthday|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=s5cdAQAAIAAJ|year=2003|publisher=Maik Nauka/Interperiodica Pub.}}</ref>
